verses.1: And on the forty-fourth day of this month, the children of Israel gathered together in groups and crowds, along with their flocks and herds.
verses.2: And the descendants of Israel were destroyed by all the nations. They stood before God and confessed their sins. They repented of their actions.
verses.3: And they stood up and read from the book of God’s laws. They did this twice a day: once when they stood up, and once when they knelt down in worship before their God.
verses.4: And above the hills stood Jesus and His disciples. They cried out loudly to the LORD, their God.
verses.5: And the Levites said, “May salvation and glory be upon You, O LORD our God. May Your name be blessed forever, from this world to the next. May all blessings and praises belong to You.”
verses.6: You alone are Jehovah, my God. You created the heavens, their names, all the stars in the earth, and everything that lives in them. You give life to all of them. The armies of heaven worship you.
verses.7: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abraham and brought him out of the land of slavery. You gave him the name “Abraham”.
verses.8: And you have found his heart to be faithful before you. And with him, you made a covenant, promising to give back the land of the Canaanites, including the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Girgashites, to their descendants. You kept your word, for you are indeed righteous.
verses.9: And you saw our ancestors in Egypt, and you heard their cries on the shore of the sea.
verses.10: And she gave gifts and offerings to Pharaoh and to all his servants, and to all the people of his land. For she knew that they had sinned against her. And so, she made you known today.
verses.11: And the sea split open before them. They crossed the sea in a narrow passage. Their enemies were thrown into the depths of the sea, like stones thrown into the waves.
verses.12: And in the light of the clouds, they were guided by day; and in the light of fire at night, so that they could find their way along the path they were to take.
verses.13: And on Mount Sinai, you descended and spoke to them from heaven. You gave them true laws and righteous statutes, along with good commandments and guidelines.
verses.14: And regarding your holy days, you know them well. I commanded them through Moses, your servant, with laws, regulations, and commandments.
verses.15: And bread from heaven was given to them to satisfy their hunger. Water also was given to them from the rocks, so that they could drink. And God said to them, “Come and take possession of the land that You have promised to give them.”
verses.16: And they and our fathers also became stubborn and refused to obey your commands.
verses.17: They listened, but they did not remember your miracles that you performed among them. They became stubborn and refused to return to serving you. But you, O God of compassion and mercy, have never abandoned them.
verses.18: Even though they made a golden calf for them, and said, “This is your God who has brought you out of Egypt,” yet they still committed great sins.
verses.19: And by your great mercy, you did not abandon them in the desert. The pillar of the cloud did not leave them alone at night, so that it could guide them along the right path. And the pillar of fire lit up the way they should walk.
verses.20: And your good spirit was given to them, so that they could learn. You did not delay from giving them water to drink.
verses.21: And for forty years, they wandered in the desert. They never lacked food or water; their feet were not damaged at all.
verses.22: And she gave them kings and queens. They were divided into tribes, and they inherited the land of Sihon and the land of King Meshishon. They also inherited the land of Og, king of Bashan.
verses.23: And in their midst, you multiplied them like stars in the sky. You brought them into the land that you promised to their ancestors would be their inheritance.
verses.24: And the Israelites came and took possession of the land. They put the Canaanites under their control. They gave them over to their own hands, along with their kings and rulers of that land, so that they could do whatever they wanted with it.
verses.25: And they captured cities in their troubles. They took over lands full of all kinds of good things: wells, orchards filled with apples and olives, and trees that produced plenty of food. They ate and feasted, and they were satisfied with your great goodness.
verses.26: They rebelled against you, they turned against you. They abandoned your laws. They killed your prophets, who testified against them so that they could be brought back to you. They did terrible things.
verses.27: And they were given back to their oppressors. They were made free by them. In times of need, they would cry out to you. And you, from heaven, will hear their cries. You will grant them great mercy, and they will be freed from their oppressors.
verses.28: And they will return to doing evil before you. But your enemies will take them away from you. They will fall into their hands, and they will cry out to you. And you, from heaven, will hear them and save them by your great mercy.
verses.29: And they were commanded to return to your law. But they refused to listen to your commands and judgments. They sinned against what a person should do. They lived in sin, and they offered their shoulders as sacrifices. Their hearts were hardened, and they did not listen.
verses.30: And many years passed over them. During those years, they were punished by your prophets’ hands. But they did not listen. So they were given over to the people of other lands.
verses.31: And by your great mercy, you did not do them all harm. You also did not abandon them, because You are merciful and compassionate.
verses.32: And now, our God, the great, powerful, and glorious God who keeps His covenant and grace, may He not fail us in all that we have received from Him as kings, priests, prophets, ancestors, and for all your people, from the time of the kings of Assyria until today.
verses.33: And you are righteous for all the suffering that has been brought upon us. For you truly did what was right, while we are the sinners.
verses.34: And our kings, our priests, and our ancestors did not obey your laws. They also did not pay attention to your commands and warnings.
verses.35: And in their kingdom, and in all the good things you have given them. And in that vast and beautiful land you have given them, they did not serve you, nor did they leave their evil ways.
verses.36: Look, today we are servants, and the land that You gave to our ancestors for them to eat its fruits and enjoy its blessings… Look, we are indeed servants of that land.
verses.37: And her reign was long for those kings who were given over to us due to our sins and wrongdoings. They ruled over us as they wished, and in great suffering we found ourselves.
